status_summary: Commerce continued to issue circumvention determinations in 2026, including a final affirmative determination on welded wire mesh from Mexico (91 FR 14526, published 2026-03-25) and a preliminary affirmative determination on aluminum containers from China completed in Vietnam (91 FR 20977, published 2026-04-20). Both notices direct Customs to collect cash deposits on uncertified entries and set importer certification duties (the second also sets exporter certification). The Mandate's specific steps of higher importer-of-record deposits or asset registration, a revived China non-market economy unit and a new Chinese normal-value method were not found in the Federal Register.

timeline.event: Commerce published in the Federal Register (91 FR 14526, signed 2026-03-20) a final affirmative circumvention determination on welded wire mesh from Mexico; entries are exempt from cash deposits only with importer certification and supporting records, and otherwise cash deposits are collected at the order rates.

Commerce published in the Federal Register (91 FR 20977) a preliminary affirmative circumvention determination on disposable aluminum containers from China completed in Vietnam, with importer and exporter certification requirements and cash deposits for uncertified entries.

title: Tighten AD/CVD enforcement against China and duty evasion
uncertainties: Circumvention rulings are an ongoing statutory activity, so they show continued enforcement rather than a new policy; the progress figure is a judgment and not_started is defensible. Federal Register API queries of International Trade Administration rules and proposed rules for the term non-market economy since 2025-01-20 returned no documents; an earlier review found only 2025-03-31 corrections to trade remedy regulations. Queries on importer-of-record deposits could not be run because of a URL length limit, so the absence of such a rule rests on the earlier review and the non-market economy query. The annual China surrogate country list memo was not opened. The aluminum container notice is preliminary and its entries on deposit case numbers contain an apparent typographic inconsistency in the fetched text. Dates are Federal Register publication dates; the web text was an unofficial rendition, and the official print edition was not compared.
